decisions.evidence: Overall, the mutagenic structural alerts and heteroatom-rich profile outweigh the more reassuring saturation and lack of aromatic rings, so the molecule is predicted to be mutagenic (B).

Since the local analogs on the not-mutagenic side are not strong enough to outweigh the mutagenicity-leaning signals seen in the negative neighbors, the combined evidence supports option (B): is mutagenic.
